subject: Workshop coordination: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, function-calls)
messages:
From: Katie Lin <katie@medlinehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted API deep-dive request — SDK + streaming + function-calls

Hi Mateo / Marissa,

Thanks again for the earlier overview. Our engineering team at MedLine would like a focused technical deep-dive on Redwood's hosted integration surface — specifically SDK patterns for streaming, recommended approaches for function/tool calling, and how to estimate token/latency costs for our clinical summarization flow.

Would you be available for a 60–75 minute workshop the week of Aug 30? Prefer afternoons PST. Also helpful if you can share any lightweight pre-reads we can circulate to the MedLine engineers.

Participants from our side: Jordan Park (backend lead) and myself.

Appreciate it —
Katie
Katie Lin
Director of Engineering, MedLine Health

--
Attachment: none (will take pre-reads)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Lin <katie@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive request — SDK + streaming + function-calls

Hi Katie —

Thanks — we can definitely run a hands-on architecture session. Proposed plan:

- 10 min: Introductions & goals (MedLine devs outline must-have outcomes)
- 20 min: Hosted API + SDK patterns (streaming, batching, auth/refresh, retry semantics)
- 20 min: Function/tool-calling patterns and safety/validation around tool outputs
- 15 min: Example run-through using a short streaming demo and Q&A

Pre-read: I attached a short architecture overview that covers runtime routing, KV/prefix caching, and quantization recommendations. Please pass to Jordan and the backend folks.

Availability: Aug 31 or Sep 1, 1:00–4:00pm PT windows work for our architects. If you prefer earlier in the week we can do Aug 30 after 3pm PT but one of our infra leads will be remote that afternoon.

Also: Could you share a brief snippet of your current inference pattern (average seq len, concurrency per request, and whether you need streaming tokens delivered incrementally vs. full response)? That will help tailor the demo.

Cheers,
Mateo
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_pre-read_arch_overview.pdf (1 page; high-level runtime and SDK notes)
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@medcare.co>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Katie Lin <katie@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive request — SDK + streaming + function-calls

Hey team —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few notes from MedLine engineering:

- We need streaming (token-by-token) to power progressive UI rendering in the clinician dashboard. Low latency is important; 99th percentile under 300ms per token would be ideal.
- Function calling will be used to normalize structured outputs into our EHR schema; we need guidance on validation and failure modes.
- Typical payload: ~400 tokens input, expected 500–900 tokens out. Concurrency initially 15–25 requests/s per endpoint, may spike.

Any chance you can include a short cost/back-of-envelope token model in the session? Helps our procurement lead assess options.

Prefer Aug 31 at 1:30pm PT. If that works, we can send calendar invites.

Jordan Park
Backend Lead, MedLine Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Katie Lin <katie@medlinehealth.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@medcare.co>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive request — SDK + streaming + function-calls

Looping in a couple technical points we should cover in the workshop — feel free to forward to MedLine: 

- SDK examples: streaming client patterns (sse/wss vs. polling), cursor/kv-cache usage for repeated prefixes, recommended client-side retry/backoff for idempotent requests.
- Runtime knobs: batching window trade-offs, per-model quantization profiles and how they impact token throughput and latency, and when to pin model variants vs. auto-fallback.
- Function call safety: signalled outputs (schema validation + checksum), verification flow (dry-run vs. forced apply), and fallback (artifact storage + manual review).
- Quick cost sketch: for their numbers, we should show per-token cost at three operating points (vanilla hosted, with batching, with prefix caching).

I put a short demo-plan in the Drive and attached a one-page checklist. Two slots that work for our infra leads: Aug 31 13:30–14:45 PT or Sep 1 14:00–15:15 PT. If Aug 31 is preferred, I'll reserve the runbook and a small demo VM for streaming tests.

-Karthik
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: hosted-integration-demo-plan.md
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Lin <katie@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API deep-dive request — SDK + streaming + function-calls

Hi Katie / Jordan —

Thanks for the details — they’re perfect. Quick scheduling update: one of our infra leads has a conflict on Aug 31; to make sure both runtime and SDK owners can attend, can we shift to Sep 1 14:00–15:15 PT? That preserves the 75-minute slot Karthik suggested.

If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda + pre-read links. Agenda will include the cost sketch and a 10-minute streaming dry-run where MedLine can observe 1–2 sample requests against a sandbox.

Proposed calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Pre-reads: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/hosted-integration-prep

If Sep 1 is a hard no, we can keep Aug 31 and I’ll escalate to find a backup for the infra slot, but the Sep 1 time is our preference.

Best,
Mateo
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — help@redwood.ai
